description: PulseKit already rate-limits its admin replay route with src/pulsekit/throttle/token_bucket.py (TokenBucket + BucketRegistry, per-key, with a Retry-After computation). The spec asks for per-API-key limits on the ingest route, which is that primitive applied to a second surface. Graded on whether the decomposition names the existing module: with the repository present, naming it is reuse; with no repository at all, naming it would be fabrication, so the same observable is graded with the opposite sign. The arm delta is what a change to the architect's repository-reading instructions moves.
